claims.assertion: Yazhi describes Suzy as a 93-meter fighter with two floors, seven seats, and compact living space.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: Yazhi says Suzy’s cockpit uses transparent polymorphous titanium and repositionable holographic displays.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: Yazhi describes two zero-point reactors powering counter-rotating electromagnetic plasma turbines.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: Yazhi says magnetic-frequency generators provide artificial gravity and cancel hull forces.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: Athena describes Sand Clock as elite fighter squadrons trained in temporal operations; each squadron has 12 fighters, and their craft have classified, stronger materials.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
